title: DAY 37/90
FIRST LAW
scenes.sub: Energy is never lost, only tracked
scenes.voice: Day thirty seven of the GATE M. E. ninety days challenge, sixty eight days to go! Week seven starts with the first law, the backbone of every thermo question.

scenes.title: Today's Topic
scenes.voice: Today's topic is the first law of thermodynamics, for closed systems and for control volumes, ending with the steady flow energy equation.

scenes.title: Cover Today
steps: Closed system: Q − W = U2 − U1
scenes.voice: Cover heat minus work equals change in internal energy, work in common processes, flow work for control volumes, then the steady flow energy equation for nozzles and turbines.

scenes.title: Quick Tip
lines: No work, no heat, KE change ≈ 0
scenes.voice: Quick tip. Across a throttling valve, enthalpy stays the same. For an ideal gas enthalpy depends only on temperature, so the temperature does not change either.

scenes.title: Today's Plan
scenes.voice: The practice PDF is on Telegram now. Test tonight, seven to nine P. M. Take it through our Telegram channel link, or simply visit our website, on mobile or laptop.
